 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Alok Kumar Pandey
 Oral Judgment

In the instant petition, petitioner has prayed for  the following relief(s):-
Vijay Pandey vs The State Of Bihar Through The Principal ... on 11 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/1471783/
1  (i) For payment of  compensation to the petitioners as the land of the  petitioners are Commercial Plot situated on  Patna High Court CWJC No.4537 of 2018 dt.11-11-2024  2/4  National Highway Road in the light of  categorization of the Government of commercial  plot in the light of the right to fair compensation  and transparency in land acquisition,
 rehabilitation and resettlement act, 2013.
 (ii) For payment of amount  of compensation to the petitioners in the light of  Notification issued by the Central Government  vide D.O. No.13013/01/2014LRD (PL) dated  26.10.2015 which was notified by the Bihar Government vide letter No. 14/DLA-Margdarshal- LA Act (Bharat Sarkar)-238/2013-1342 dated 14.12.2015 in the light of Section 24 (i) (a) of the Provision of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013 for payment of compensation to the petitioners in the light of Market value of the land on 01.01.2014.

entities.text: Vijay Pandey vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (iii) For any other relief/reliefs for which the petitioners are entitled under the law in the light of fact and circumstances of the case in the interest of justice.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioners have only grievance that they have not received enhanced amount of compensation for the land which has been acquired for construction of National Highways in the light of notification issued by the Central Government vide D.O. No. 13013/01/2014-LRD(PL) dated 26.10.2015 which was also adopted by the Government of Bihar.

He further submits that award has been prepared on 27.09.2016 and petitioners have got compensation on the basis of the agricultural land and by virtue Patna High Court CWJC No.4537 of 2018 dt.11-11-2024 of aforesaid notification the rate has been enhanced for the land which has been acquired for construction of the National Highway and petitioners are entitled to get compensation on the basis of enhanced rate by virtue of aforesaid notification but learned counsel for the petitioners admitted that petitioners have not made any representation for redressal of their grievances before competent authority.

3. Learned counsel appearing for NHAI and the State on the basis of material available on record have submitted that petitioners have not represented before competent authority for redressal of their grievances under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956 and hence, this petition is not maintainable.
4.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and the submissions advanced on behalf of Vijay Pandey vs The State Of Bihar Through The Principal ... on 11 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/1471783/
2 the parties, the present writ petition stands disposed of with liberty to petitioners to raise their grievances before the Arbitrator under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956 within a period of four weeks from the date of receipt of this order.
